checks.lead: Krim Belkacem (Kabyle: Belqasem Krim, Arabic: كريم بلقاسم; 14 September 1922 – 18 October 1970) was an Algerian revolutionary and politician who was a notable figure during the Algerian War. As vice-president of the GPRA, he was the sole signatory of the Évian Accords on the Algerian side. After the 1965 coup d'état, he went into exile and was assassinated in West Germany in 1970.
